findings.title: Bind restrictive child umask before requiring legacy output mode0600
findings.observed: The DATA grammar requires both sidecars and original legacy wrapper to be ordinary nonsymlink0600 source-written files. Sidecars explicitly open0600; the unchanged legacy hook uses writeFileSync(legacy,bytes) without a mode option. The proposed launch contract binds paths/environment but no umask. A fresh legacy file under inherited022 is0644, so a genuine otherwise-valid positive run can fail the proposed grammar. The0700 containing directory protects traversal but does not make its file0600. No permission state was probed or assumed for an actual run.
findings.neededPrecision: Before any helper/positive execution release, explicitly bind a source-preserving umask077 on the owned test child before it creates the absent legacy path, retain that launch precondition and verify acquired mode0600. Do not precreate the legacy file, chmod/rewrite captured evidence afterward, weaken sidecarwx ownership, or change product code. Root may choose another explicit contract-preserving acquisition design; it needs the same native/root mechanics closure.
findings.effect: Contract precision prerequisite; not a source defect or current secrecy-leak claim. All execution already closed.
